decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with no project or key milestone; one invite sent shows some intent (email:e9170956), but Mateo has never replied to either outreach (email:389d44a5, email:e9170956) and filed no tickets, suggesting low engagement. 8 days remain, so self-activation is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Cedar Group's first project started
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Now that you've got a teammate in Wrenfield, the natural next step is your first project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and I'm happy to walk it with you.

Would a short call this week work? Tell me a time that suits and I'll send an invite. If it's easier, reply here with what Cedar Group is trying to track first and I'll point you to the quickest starting point.

Best,
Nadia
